description: This file contains declarations, macros, and function prototypes for validation of TrueTypeGX/AAT tables in the FreeType project, including lookup tables, state tables, glyph ID validation, control point validation, SFNT name validation, and handling of table overlaps.

methods.name: gxv_BinSrchHeader_validate
methods.description: Validates the header of a lookup table in the font data.

methods.name: gxv_LookupTable_validate
methods.description: Validates a lookup table in the font data.

methods.name: gxv_StateTable_subtable_setup
methods.description: Sets up a state table subtable.

methods.name: gxv_XStateTable_subtable_setup
methods.description: Sets up an extended (32-bit) state table subtable.

methods.name: gxv_array_getlimits_byte
methods.description: Gets min and max limits for a byte array.

methods.name: gxv_array_getlimits_ushort
methods.description: Gets min and max limits for a ushort array.

methods.name: gxv_set_length_by_ushort_offset
methods.description: Sets length based on ushort offset.

methods.name: gxv_set_length_by_ulong_offset
methods.description: Sets length based on ulong offset.

methods.name: gxv_odtect_add_range
methods.description: Adds a range for table overlap detection.
